info.name: LEMS SCNMTC Backend
info.description:
LEMS SCNMTC backend API.

1. Import this collection and the 'LEMS local' environment, and select the environment.
2. Start the API (php artisan serve) and create the demo accounts (php artisan db:seed --class=DemoUsersSeeder). Demo accounts are synthetic and local only. Their password is DEMO_PASSWORD from the API's .env ('password' when not set): put the same value in the environment variable demo_password.
3. Send one request from '1. Sign in as...'. The token is saved automatically.
4. Every request has tests: open the 'Test Results' tab after sending to see green or red.
5. To check everything at once, run ONLY the folder '9. Automated checks' in the Collection Runner (re-run 'php artisan db:seed --class=DemoUsersSeeder' first if you changed demo passwords).
6. For the marks, release and results part of the demo, run ONLY the folder '13. Demo flow end to end' on fresh demo data (php artisan migrate:fresh --seed); submitting marks is permanent.

The OpenAPI spec (docs/api/openapi.json) is the source of truth; if this collection disagrees with it, the spec wins.

item.description: A scripted walk through the whole demo flow (sign-in, users, registration windows, registering a student, the student registering for courses, password resets, the audit log) with an assertion on every step. In Postman: right-click this folder > Run folder (or use the Runner and select only this folder). All steps should be green. It leaves one invited user, one student and one registration window behind per run. It does not change any demo password.

item.description: Registration is in folder 9. This folder walks the rest of the Monday demo with an assertion on every step: the lecturer saves and submits marks (and the lock refuses changes), the Head of Academics reviews and releases, the student sees a letter grade and credit hours only. It uses the seeded demo accounts and the first of lecturer@demo.test's courses that has students and no marks. Submitting is permanent, so to run it again reset the demo data first: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed (local database only).
